items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: The Tifferet of ZA is considered his essence, from the aspect of the clothing of the lights in the vessels. For it is always drawn from the second expansion, which is the phase of AB, which is the first filling, to the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter, after its refinement, as is known. And in the Partzuf of AB the degrees descended, and KHB became HBD, and Tifferet became the phase of Netzah, which is the essence of ZA, as above in answer 141. (Page 33)
